name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: If both Gnome does not go with 45 gp and Gnome goes with Kael, then 40 gp goes with Human.
Either Lyra goes with Human or 30 gp goes with Dragonborn.
Either Tiefling goes with Kael or 30 gp goes with Thorne.
Thorne, 35 gp, and 40 gp go with Gnome, Human, and Tiefling, in some order.
Tiefling, 35 gp, and 40 gp go with Kael, Lyra, and Thorne, in some order.

hints.text: Suppose Thorne went with Dragonborn — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Thorne goes with Dragonborn.
Thorne goes with Dragonborn, so it can't also go with Gnome.
Thorne goes with Dragonborn, so it can't also go with Human.
Thorne goes with Dragonborn, so it can't also go with Tiefling.
…but now the clue “Thorne, 35 gp, and 40 gp go with Gnome, Human, and Tiefling, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Thorne does not go with Dragonborn.
